title: Propidium Iodide (PI) Staining Method
author: Dr. Steven Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ibxcapn

steps.title: Prepare cell samples
steps.instruction: Prepare cells by adding 25% glycerol (growcells.com Catalog #MRGE-4002).

substeps.instruction: Store samples at -20ºC for up to 30 days if necessary.

steps.title: Prepare staining stock solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare DAPI and PI stock solutions and sterilize them.

substeps.instruction: Add DAPI at 50 µg/mL in dH2O.
Add PI at 500 µg/mL in dH2O.
Filter sterilize using a 0.2 µm Millipore filter.
Store the sterilized solutions in the dark at 4ºC.

steps.title: Stain the cells
steps.instruction: Stain the diluted cell samples with DAPI and PI.

substeps.instruction: Dilute cells appropriately according to the sample.
Add DAPI to a final concentration of 5 µg/mL.
Add PI to a final concentration of 3 µg/mL.
Incubate in the dark for 30 min.

steps.title: Filter and mount samples
steps.instruction: Filter the stained cells and mount them for microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Filter sample onto a 0.2 µm black polycarbonate filter under low vacuum (<15 mmHg).
Mount the filter onto a glass slide using low fluorescence immersion oil.

steps.title: Image the samples
steps.instruction: View the sample using a Leica DM4000-6000 epifluorescent microscope.

substeps.instruction: Use the Texas Red N3 filter.
